focus: Ran the full /doctor:* engine battery in read-only modes, quoted exit code and byte length per engine, and mapped pass/fail legibility plus mirror body-parity blindness
answeredQuestions: What concrete extensions to doctor checks, hooks, CI and mirror sync would close a gap found in this run?

graphEvents.label: Concrete extensions for doctor checks, hooks, CI and mirror sync
No shared doctor exit-code contract, release-update returns 0 on unknown
Documented install check refuses in the Skilled checkout with an unremedied error
parent-skill-check prints Advisory findings: FAIL on a passing run
Runtime-mirrors hook battery is existence-only and its degraded verdict is prose
Copy-backed mirror hosts defeat existence checks; sanctioned and stale deltas are indistinguishable
commit-msg fail-open on a repo that declares no rules is documented, repro still blocked
CI can run the existing offline doctor suites today

label: Doctor has no shared exit-code contract: route-validate.sh publishes a 0/1/2/3 taxonomy while release-update.cjs check --offline exits 0 with all 20 units reading 'unknown (ancestry)' and no RESULT line, so CI and the AI user cannot distinguish unknown from aligned; update.md documents no exit code and release-update.md does not exist.

The documented install inspection fails in the Skilled checkout: install.md step 3 and doctor-install.yaml run symlink-engine.cjs check --root <dir> while the workflow binds only --root and --runtimes, and the engine exits 2 with 'ERROR: root and source must not contain one another', a message that names no remedy and no --source escape.

parent-skill-check prints 'INFO: Advisory findings: FAIL. Hard failures always FAIL.' in the first four lines of a run that ends 'OK: parent-skill-check - all hard invariants passed, 0 warnings' and exits 0, so an operator or a truncated AI read sees failure on a green run.

route-validate.sh prints 11 warnings before its verdict, six of them 'allowed but informational' flag-duplication notes, and the only severity marker is the prose parenthetical, so a reader cannot triage without reading every line before the final OK.

The --help contract is per-engine, not shared: overlay-engine --help prints a usage block and exits 0 exactly as doctor-overlay-apply.yaml:65 promises, while symlink-engine, ci-toggle, sk-skill-check and parent-skill-check each answer --help with an unknown-option error and exit 2 with no usage block.

The runtime-mirrors hook battery is existence-only: all 66 rows are type file_exists and all 66 paths resolve today, while the degraded verdict is an instruction to the model (doctor-runtime-mirrors.yaml:148) rather than a script, so no exit code and no deterministic 'N hook adapters degraded' count exist.

Most mirror hosts are copies rather than symlinks (.pi 400 markdown files and 0 symlinks, .codex 48/0, .dsh 50/0, .opencode 37/1, versus .claude 45 symlinks), so a stale body satisfies every existence check; and sanctioned deltas are indistinguishable from drift, since .codex/hooks/README.md is 3676 B against a 41311 B source and is intentionally a discovery pointer by its own frontmatter while .pi/agents deltas of ~128 B pass the presence-only agent-roster-mirror-check.

The install-checklist fail-open is confirmed by code: commit-msg documents exit 0 for 'the repository declares no commit rules', rules resolve only from skgit.contractDir then the first of .sk-git/.skilled/.opencode, and the hook is installed machine-wide through the global hooksPath, so a repo with hooks and none of those dirs accepts a malformed commit by design; the exception appears in the hook header and the installed README but the live /tmp repro remains blocked by this run's write scope.

The two hook layers are not duplicates and neither is dead - the six live .git/hooks are symlinks into .opencode/scripts/git-hooks while .skilled/skills/sk-git/scripts/hooks holds the PreToolUse agent gate - but sk-git's own hooks README contains no .sk-git or contractDir text, so the documentation an operator reaches from sk-git never names the hook code that actually gates their commits.

Every doctor engine already has an offline test file beside it (ci-toggle, overlay-engine x5, parent-skill-check x5, release-update, route-validate, sk-skill-check, symlink-engine) and the hooks have .opencode/scripts/git-hooks/tests, so CI could gate on them without gh or network; whether .github/workflows already does was not re-verified this iteration, and wiring them before fixing the exit-code disagreement would bake the ambiguity in.

Battery measured: symlink-engine check --root . exit 2 (51 B), overlay-engine status --root . exit 2 (261 B, the most actionable message in the set), overlay-engine --help exit 0 (387 B), release-update check --offline exit 0 (3638 B, no RESULT line), route-validate exit 0 (2901 B, 11 warnings), sk-skill-check check sk-git exit 0 (1101 B, Result: PASS), parent-skill-check sk-code exit 0 (5044 B, OK 0 warnings)

direction: Claiming the .codex 3676 B vs 41311 B README delta and the 11 .pi/agents size deltas as mirror drift
reason: Read the file before claiming: .codex/hooks/README.md declares itself a discovery-only pointer mirror in its own frontmatter, and agent-roster-mirror-check reports 11/11 present per runtime with STATUS=OK, so a size delta alone proves nothing and these are sanctioned shapes rather than stale copies
